notes.title: Tell Some Story: Foz Update 1.0.09
notes.content:
[b]Greetings to all interested.[/b]
I'm sorry for not making a description for each update, but I don't think it's necessary for a single player game.
Now the version is already 1.0.09, there were a lot of optimization and balance fixes.
Some of the fixes were related to the system of covers and other kinds of triggers.
For a comfortable game, you just need to read tips / tasks, use cover and take your time, unless of course this is a mission with a helicopter.

[list]
[*]
AI accuracy has been reduced by 1.5 degrees from the target.
[*]
The pursuing helicopter is now slower by 10 seconds, but players continue to hide from it instead of running.
[*]
Fixed issue with weapons in some missions.
[*]
[b]Numerous text edits.[/b]
I also want to make an announcement, now we are working with the English version of the game, this time it’s not Google that helps me, but a person who speaks English, as soon as all the text is corrected, there will be an update. Unfortunately, translation into other languages is not yet planned, there were no people willing to help for free, and I have no money.
[*]
Fixed enemy damage.
[*]
Some characters have been moved to more prominent places.
[*]
Many other minor optimization fixes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853381/d4016abbe909bb8d91c5fb47f228a0569d64499d.png[/img]

Thank you for your support and feedback, this is my first game and I'm really trying to make something interesting.
Despite the small number of sales, you motivated me to start working on a free DLC!
The main character, whose story will intersect with characters you know, will show the story from a different angle.

notes.title: Tell Some Story: Foz Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40853381/d5b4cfdf636eb031b9dc6f2ab32792ccdc963d71.png[/img]

[b]Greetings to all interested.[/b]
I continue to fix the identified problems, at least those that I can.
In the near future there will be a patch fixing the loss of frames after the laboratory complex, it seems to me that I have found the source of the problem.
I was asked about the development of the project, and I want to present you a roadmap.
DLC development will begin after a certain number of copies have been sold.
All DLC will be absolutely free.

[list]
[*]
500 - 15 additional endings and a gallery with all dialogue characters.
[*]
1000 - A small side DLC will be added about a minor character whose history intersects with Foz.
[*]
2000 - DLC will be added with the story of one of the policemen who meet in the story.
[*]
5000 - DLC will be added with the story of one of the members of the TRGG corporation.
[*]
10000 - the choice of the community, several characters will be nominated for a vote and the one with the most votes will become the main character of the last DLC.
[/list]
All copies sold before 2/2/2024 are counted.
The final date can be moved, with the active participation of the community, if we succeed and the game gains at least some audience, I will continue to support it.
Thank you all for your feedback and support.
